description: A meeting event in which Jonas encounters Adam, an older manifestation of his own persistent identity, in 1921.
A meeting event in which adult Charlotte holds her infant self in 1971 before leaving her with H. G. Tannhaus.
A meeting event in which Adult Helge collides with the car driven by Old Helge, who is attempting to kill his younger self in order to stop Noah.
A meeting event in which adult Helge encounters his young child self inside the Doppler bunker in 1986.
A meeting event in which young Jonas encounters his adult self (The Stranger) while locked in the bunker in 1986.
A meeting event in which adult Claudia meets her elderly self (Old Claudia) in 1987 and receives instructions about time travels.
A meeting event in which young Martha encounters Eva, the elderly manifestation of her own persistent identity, in Erit Lux headquarters.
